announcements.headline: Statement re Securitisation Substitution
announcements.insight: This announcement indicates a structural change to the securitisation vehicle, which typically involves replacing an underlying asset or counterparty within the financial instrument. For shareholders, this signifies an administrative update to the financing structure rather than a fundamental shift in the parent company's strategic direction.
